name: heart
description: A balanced heart with full lobes and a softened lower point.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: The lower flanks bow outward in continuous convex Bezier curves before meeting a softened point, replacing the straight diagonal taper. Left and right curves are mirrored and tangent-aligned at the lower joins. Upper lobes retain the current rounded construction. Outline bounds x=3.25..20.75, y=4.1..19.9 remain centered. Review study; not owner-approved. Lower fullness reduced after owner feedback: a moderate convex bow replaces the earlier broad flare; upper geometry and outer bounds are preserved.
